COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
CRJA No.140 of 2023
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. V.K. Gemini, DAG, for the State of 
Uttarakhand/respondent.
This jail appeal has been preferred by the 
appellant/convict, who is presently languishing 
in jail, as against the judgment of the 
conviction, impugned in the appeal. 
The High Court Legal Services Authority 
is directed to provide a free legal aid to the 
appellant to pursue the appeal.
List as soon as the needful is done by the 
High Court Legal Services Authority, for 
considering the appeal for admission.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 20.10.2023

COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
CRJA No.140 of 2023
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Sandeep Adhikari, Legal Aid Counsel for the 
appellant appeared through video conferencing. 
2. Ms. Pushpa Bhatt, Addl. CSC with Mr. S.C. Dumka, 
AGA for the State.
3. This appeal is filed from jail by the appellant.
4. The present appeal is directed against the judgment 
and order dated 15.09.2023 passed by the Special Session 
Judge, Bageshwar in Session Trial No.6 of 2022, State vs. 
Mahender Ram, whereby the appellant has been convicted 
under Section 8 read with Sections 20(b)(ii)(C) of NDPS Act, 
1985 and was sentenced 10 years rigorous imprisonment 
and a fine of Rs.1,00,000/- with default stipulation six 
months additional imprisonment. 
5. The appeal is within time.
6. Admit the appeal.
7. Summon the lower court record.
8. List this case on 10.12.2025. 
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 29.10.2025
Ravi
